summary: Banco Santander's Form 6-K reports the completion of the Poland disposal and the announcement of the Webster acquisition. Santander acquired 100% of Webster Financial Corporation for USD 12.2 billion (approx. EUR 10.3 billion). Webster shareholders receive USD 48.75 per share in cash (65%) and 2.0548 Santander ADS per share (35%), based on a three-day VWAP of EUR 10.79 per Santander share and EUR/USD 1.1840. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals and Webster shareholder approval. The Poland disposal closed on 9 January 2026, with Erste acquiring Santander Poland for EUR 7 billion in cash (584 zlotys/share, 7.5% premium over 2 May 2025 close). Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder vote timeline.
